name: Zechariah
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return

points: “Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo”: this is where the class is, Zechariah’s leadership. They “prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel”.

It got so bad that Zerubbabel, who was the leader, and Joshua the high priest stopped building. They stopped the building because there were so many problems: the other nations were hiring people against us, all the secret plots, the commotions. So the Lord raised up Zechariah and Haggai and said, prophesy to Zerubbabel and Joshua.

The elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo; and they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
The elders prospered through the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah and finished the house by the commandment of the Most High and of the Persian kings.

note.label: Ezra 6: The Decree Confirmed And The House Dedicated

points: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius: the book of Zechariah is during the time of the Persian Mede captivity.
In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet.

note.label: Zechariah 1: Turn Ye Unto Me, and I Will Turn Unto You

points: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah.

note.label: Zechariah 1: Turn Ye Unto Me, and I Will Turn Unto You

points: In the fourth year of king Darius, in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu, the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?
